column2: The  general  objects  for  which    the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to provide relief for Buddhist persons who are victims
of  terrorism,  ethnic  violence  or  any  racial
discrimination or aggression ;
to advance the moral,  cultural, economic and social
welfare of Buddhist persons of Sri Lanka ;
to preserve Buddhist cultural heritage of Sri Lanka

and  places  of  archeological 
importance 
to
Buddhists;
to  promote  and  facilitate  research  on  Sinhala
language, culture and history ;
to promote the interests of Buddhism ;
to foster Theravada Buddhist Doctrine and way of
life ;
to provide facilities for the study of Buddhism ;
to encourage practical observance of Buddhism ;
to promote unity and co-operation  among   Buddhist
organizations  and  Buddhists  both  nationally,  and
internationally  ;
to provide welfare facilities to  Buddhist persons ;
to  provide  educational  and  vocational  training
facilities to needy  Buddhist persons ;
to  aid  and  assist  Buddhist  persons  to  commence
and  operate  agricultural,  industrial  or  commercial
ventures;
to  co-operate  with  other  Buddhist  associations  ,
societies or organizations having objects similar to
those of the Corporation.
